items.claim: Joshua Van looked phenomenal in his last fight against Tatsuro Taira.
items.quote: how good did he look against Tatsuro Taira? What a phenomenal fight

items.claim: Alexandre Pantoja walks forward, punches into a clinch, and looks to secure takedowns and submissions.
items.quote: Alexandre Pantoja, we know he's going to walk forward, he's going to punch into a clinch, he's going to look to take him down, take him down, rear-naked choke, whatever, submissions galore

items.claim: Arman Tsarukyan made short work of Dan Hooker in his last fight.
items.quote: taking on Dan Hooker, made short work of him.

items.claim: Arman Tsarukyan has been absent from competition for almost a year.
items.quote: he's been absent. It's been almost a bloody year.

items.claim: Arman Tsarukyan will likely be able to ragdoll Mateusz Rebeçki based on Benoît Saint Denis's performance.
items.quote: if Benoît Saint Denis can ragdoll Mateusz Rebeçki all around the place, then you better bet your bottom dollar that Arman Tsarukyan can.
